cells.label: The Wheel of Fortune - a great turning gold wheel inscribed with sigils, sphinx perched on top, serpent descending one side, jackal-headed figure rising the other
Death - skeletal knight in black armor astride a pale horse, carrying a black banner with a white rose
The Tower - a lightning-struck stone tower come alive as a striding golem, its crown blasted off and burning, tiny figures falling from its windows
Knight of Wands - armored rider on a rearing horse brandishing a flaming sprouting staff
Knight of Cups - graceful armored rider on a calm white horse holding out a golden chalice
Knight of Swords - charging rider on a storm-grey horse, sword thrust forward, cloak whipping
Knight of Pentacles - patient armored rider on a heavy black draft horse, holding a gold coin-disc
